scope: Q04 reachable held endpoint round2: one native-geometry candidate, two healthy longsword hold conditions, explicit contribution decomposition
decision: Reject for isolated mobile/public trial and general adoption. Native-length solve removes a verified5mm FK/model mismatch, but goal projection alone is physically exact to prior latch; raw impossible requests remain in down141/144frames, up raw tracking worsens about2.2mm, explicit shoulder work and gaps regress in some pairs. No second candidate or broad extension justified.
attributionModes: projectionOnly diagnostic: goal relabel, no actuation effect
lengthOnly diagnostic: native-length solve, raw goal unchanged
nativeReach candidate: native solve + reported applied goal

protocol.candidate: Native shoulder/elbow/grip lengths and native elbow limits define held IK reach shell, using existing ARM.slack. LengthOnly changes actual IK; projectionOnly just reports original IK clamped goal. NativeReach combines native-length IK and explicit applied goal. Reuses prior held input latch. No transforms/velocities/gains/strength/native-joint edits.
protocol.input: Same actual longsword down/up drag.55s, hold1.2s, preparation3s legacy, pairedmeasurement,seed7. Scripted endpoints only; human pointer jitter/intention unresolved.
protocol.budget: Strict paired numerical final shoulder/wrist cap schedule from capHeld. Native elbow/elbowGravity/offHand excluded.
protocol.work: Path signed midpoint work includes reaction bodies; sword gravity exact actual COM potential change. No native total-work claim.
protocol.reach: Raw goal and actual solved/report goal are separate. Native FK reconstructed from actual joint anchor vectors and JS target quaternions; applying goal uses pre-step chest. Off-grip distance currently post-step chest diagnosis; no full shoulder cone guarantee.

lifecycle.scope: Actual G.step lifecycle with scripted input only; full candidate switches native-length IK off on new input/release. New input .03m is a fixture, not human pointer-jitter intent.

geometry.scope: Hypothetical JS joint-target forward kinematics from actual native anchors. No rigid body position/velocity writes; not physical tracking or motor work.

attribution: projectionOnly vs held entire native/physical/control trace exact; nativeReach vs lengthOnly entire native/physical/control trace exact. Reported hand-goal/error improvement caused by goal relabel is not physical tracking improvement.
fkReadout: 9 static actual-anchor fixtures: original reconstructed endpoint error≈.005m, native solve maxerror<5e−16m, no native bodies changed. Runtime pre-step float quaternion/native reads produce max native FK error<.2micrometre; tracked separately from actual physical hand error.

supersededEvidence.reason: Same20physics rows; preliminary FK diagnostic used post-step chest pose vs pre-step goal. Final replay corrected FK timing and added full native-solve reset/rearm/FK fixtures. Repeated trajectories not independent samples.

limits: Candidate uses measured sword-arm ball/hinge/grip anchor geometry and existing5mm ARM.slack; no gains/force limits/native body settings changed. Inner radius from existing hinge2.5rad limit also included, but close/fold scenes untested.
Only longsword down/up healthy hold. No collision/wound/duel/mobile/user jitter or intention acceptance.
Off-grip radial diagnostic did not bind initial cases; it is post-step pose readout and does not prove off-shoulder angular-cone reach. No two-hand intersection candidate was added.

Existing input coordinates and blade direction preserved; original held follow target remains outside physical sword-arm reach for down141frames. Applied feasible sphere goal is not fulfillment of that raw input.
Native lengths are applied only while latched; actual new input/release restores original Skill/IK arithmetic. Switching controller geometry at boundary remains untested in extended gameplay.
Strict numerical caps bound final explicit shoulder+wrist only; native elbow/elbowGravity/offHand work and limits not included.
Signed explicit path work uses midpoint quadrature including reactions; native/contact total work not measured.
Original has no ledger so its zero work counters are unavailable, not measured zero. Clone FK diagnostic is unavailable; observed exact clone trajectory supplies the legacy FK evidence.
humanTrialStatus: Not ready. No isolated mobile implementation/deployment made; this failed comparison should not be offered as an improved control trial. Need a changed input endpoint design that demonstrates same-input raw tracking and reach improvements plus restart/release and healthy/wound/duel/mobile gates.
nextMinimalHypothesis: Choose a source-mapped input endpoint within the physical arm/grip region by modifying the follow extension itself, with explicit original endpoint/remaining intent error; prove the nonlinear guard mapping and first intervention before trying another projection or gain. Native length correction may be retained as a separately verified model-consistency finding, not a solved held-input design.

report.scope: 독립 읽기 원자료·코드·문서 감사. 신규 물리 실행 없음.

findings.detail: 표의 axis error 숫자는 실제 afterInputBladeAxisTravelRad였다. 누적 이동량은 종말 방향 오차/정지거리와 다르다. Root가 문서 표제와 방향 개선 문구를 정정했고, 실제문서36/38/45행 및 실제종료오차열 추가를 재확인했다. 실제 final.bladeAimErrorRad는 비교4쌍 모두 소폭 증가하므로 개선 주장 불가.
projectionOnly는 입력 Vector3의 보고목표를 clamp하지만 현재경로의joint목표와물리궤적을바꾸지않는다. nativeReach=lengthOnly exact는동일실험에서확인된사실이며다른호출자가target객체를제어에재사용하는경로까지일반화하지않는다.

FK 오차는 actual native anchors와JS joint target quaternion으로구한가상끝점과동일pre-physics chest 기반appliedGoal의대조다. 실제손tracking오차/인간관절도달가능성은아니다. 실제post-step손과pre-step원래목표의raw intent error를별도로유지하여clamp후보고오차감소를성공으로세지않았다.
firstLatch controller SHA는입력/Skill부분집합이고firstIK SHA는Skill+주팔/팔꿈치target+rawGoal이다. 준비전체physical/controller와stroke native exact와함께읽어야하며모든숨은controller필드동일의별도증명은아니다.
